invariants.rationale: The parameter records should not be null to avoid NullPointerException when streaming.
The number of output partitions is expected to be a positive integer for repartitioning.
If the list is not empty, all HoodieRecord items should be non-null for correct processing.
List size is always non-negative by definition.
It is common for the number of partitions not to exceed the number of input records, unless the list is empty.
